backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining data types, comparator modules, authorization mixin usage, and CRUD-style functions for profiles and other domain entities stored in maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a landing page headline-update task to its related file and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of many frontend components and pages across the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining color tokens, dark mode variables, and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts, metadata, and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routes, layout, theme provider, and profile-setup logic.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity auth flow and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog prompting first‑time users to submit name and bio to create a profile.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Wrapper component enforcing authentication and showing a sign‑in prompt when needed.
Clickable brand logo linking to home with image, wordmark, and hover/focus animations.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Reusable empty-state card component with optional hero image, icon, text, and action slot.
frontend/src/components/events/CreateEve: Modal form for creating an event, validating inputs and submitting via useCreateEvent.
frontend/src/components/events/EventCard: Displays event info in a card with formatted date and navigation to the event detail page.
frontend/src/components/feed/FeedPostCar: Renders a feed post with author info, timestamp formatting, and content.
frontend/src/components/feed/PostCompose: Composer card for creating new posts with auth checks and submit handling.
frontend/src/components/groups/CreateGro: Modal dialog for creating a group with name and description validation.
frontend/src/components/groups/GroupCard: Card showing group name, description, and member count with navigation to the group page.
App layout with navigation, authentication-aware links, and responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/marketing/FaqSec: FAQ section rendering collapsible questions and answers with animations.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Timeli: Renders a marketing timeline section displaying four milestone cards with animations and icons.
frontend/src/components/mechanics/Mechan: Displays mechanic details including location, rating, specialties, contact info, and a button to contact them.
Modal dialog allowing users to describe and submit a mechanic help request, handling authentication and form validation.
frontend/src/components/trips/TripSugges: Card showing trip details such as route, duration, type, and optional waypoint badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating related queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller’s user profile and loading profiles for other users via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts: Provides hooks to fetch events and create, join, or leave events with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFeed.ts: Hooks to fetch the feed and create new posts, refreshing feed and profile data on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroups.ts: Hooks for listing groups and performing group creation, join, and leave actions with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context, exposing identity state, login, and logout utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useMechanics.ts: Hooks for listing mechanics, submitting mechanic requests, and retrieving the user’s past requests.
frontend/src/hooks/useProfileOverview.ts: React Query hook fetching a user's profile overview via actor and identity, returning lists of posts, groups, events, and mechanic requests.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file for organizing query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useTripSuggestions.ts: Mutation hook that calls actor.suggestTrips with mapped trip type variants.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables, typography, and component styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, QueryClient, InternetIdentity, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, values, and platform highlights.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays contact methods and support information with links and styled cards.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed event info and enables joining or leaving events with authentication.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Lists upcoming events with sorting, creation dialog, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: Displays details for a specific group, allows authenticated users to join or leave, and handles loading or missing group states.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Lists all groups with sorting, creation options, and authentication checks, showing loading or empty states as needed.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page showcasing platform features, steps, and hero content with animations.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsPage.tsx: Fetches and displays certified mechanics, showing loading or empty states and enabling contact via a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPage.tsx: Static privacy policy page outlining data practices, user rights, and platform policies.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Authenticated user profile page showing user info with tabs for posts, groups, events, and mechanic requests.
frontend/src/pages/SocialFeedPage.tsx: Displays the social feed with post creation and sorted posts, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/TripPlannerPage.tsx: React page providing a trip planning form that validates input and triggers trip suggestion fetching, then displays results or an empty state.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, fonts, animations, and container settings with plugins for animation and typography.
project_state.json: JSON snapshot describing project state, branding updates, architecture notes, and existing feature definitions with versions.
